name: Omni Grove Park Inn
insider_take: This legendary Blue Ridge Mountain resort has been enchanting guests since 1913 with its massive stone fireplaces, world-class spa carved into a mountainside, and breathtaking views of the Appalachian wilderness.
whats_special: The Grove Park Inn boasts the largest collection of Arts and Crafts furniture in the world, displayed throughout its Great Hall. The hotel's underground spa features natural rock formations and waterfalls, while its Donald Ross-designed golf course has hosted presidents and celebrities for over a century.
pro_tip: Visit during October for peak fall foliage views from your room, and don't miss the massive stone fireplaces in the Great Hall—they're so large you can literally walk inside them.
dont_miss: Take the sunset terrace stroll for panoramic Blue Ridge Mountain vistas, explore downtown Asheville's vibrant craft brewery scene just 15 minutes away, and experience the mystical underground spa tunnels carved directly into the granite mountainside.
pros: Historic luxury resort with stunning Blue Ridge Mountain views
World-class spa featuring natural mineral pools and cave treatments
Championship golf course designed by Donald Ross
Multiple dining venues including award-winning restaurants
Extensive outdoor activities and seasonal programming
cons: Mountain location requires planning for seasonal weather
